posts.title: half idle, fully busy
posts.description: A Node pod saturated at 100% event-loop utilization reads 49% CPU, so a CPU-targeting autoscaler never fires. Why the two numbers diverge in both directions, what to scale on instead, and two fleets you can watch.

posts.title: not everything belongs in state
posts.description: A drag handle that updates React state on every pointermove re-renders the layout at input speed. Three tiers of state, where per-frame gesture state actually belongs, and a side-by-side divider you can drag.

posts.title: no one has to agree
posts.description: How two people can edit the same document with no server deciding the order: why naive position-based merging breaks, what operational transform and CRDTs each do about it, and a live two-replica demo you can type into.
